name: Heavy cable and busbar
summary: Thick copper and aluminium cable and busbar for high current: battery, welding and service cable.
uses: Battery bank, inverter and starter cables
Busbars for battery and solar wiring
identify: Battery cables in every vehicle and forklift, welding leads, jumper cables, UPS and inverter cables, and thick service cable at meters and panels. Busbars are flat copper bars in panels, UPS units and switchgear.
test: Check insulation and lugs for corrosion: green or white crust adds resistance and heat. A cable too thin for the current gets hot.
